What is VAF, and what minimum do we use for somatic calling?

VAF (variant allele frequency) is the fraction of sequencing reads at a position that carry the variant. The default minimum for reportable somatic calls is **0.05 (5%)**, with at least 20 reads at the variant position in the tumor library. [sop-var-001-v2@2:L6-L8]

The validation supports a 0.05 detection limit at 40× tumor coverage; at 30×, the limit rises to 0.08. [val-som-2025-v1@1:L6-L8]
